scenario.topic: Decide which cloud provider to migrate the app to
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us when choosing a cloud provider: cost, performance, or ease of migration?

options.name: Amazon Web Services EC2 and RDS
options.upside: Industry-leading scalability and global availability zones
options.tradeoff: Higher complexity in configuration and management
options.concern: Potentially steep learning curve for the team

options.name: Microsoft Azure App Services and SQL Database
options.upside: Faster migration with strong integration to existing Microsoft stack
options.tradeoff: Slightly less mature ecosystem for some open-source tools
options.concern: Support outside business hours may be limited
options.best_for: teams invested in Microsoft technologies and faster migration

options.name: Google Cloud Platform Compute Engine and Cloud SQL
options.upside: Strong machine learning and data analytics tools
options.tradeoff: Migration may take longer due to less mature migration tooling
options.concern: Potential vendor lock-in with proprietary APIs
options.best_for: teams focused on data and AI capabilities

options.name: DigitalOcean Droplets and Managed Databases
options.upside: Lowest cost and fastest migration time
options.concern: Limited support options for critical incidents
options.best_for: small teams prioritizing cost and speed

shared_context: The team consists of exactly 6 participants.
